dc_eval_cbrn.note: Full read (pp.1-58): no CBRN or dangerous-capability evaluation; only capability benchmarks. Keywords absent from text.

dc_eval_cyber.note: Full read: no offensive cyber evaluation; Terminal Bench/SWE are general agent benchmarks.

dc_eval_autonomy.note: Full read: no replication, AI R&D risk or autonomy risk evaluation. 'R&D Coding Benchmark' (Sec 5.4.4) is a capability benchmark of internal engineering tasks, and 'long-horizon' appears only as a capability motive.

dc_eval_persuasion.note: Full read: no persuasion or manipulation evaluation.

dc_eval_scheming.note: Full read: no deception, sabotage, sandbagging or eval-awareness evaluation. Reward model use is a training method, not a misalignment evaluation.

framework_threshold.note: Full read: no safety or scaling framework referenced.

ext_test_any.note: Only outside party is 'Dolly Deng and other testers' thanked for feedback on capabilities (A.2); capability feedback, not safety or risk testing per v1.1 clarification 2. Gemini/Opus comparisons are benchmarks, not testing.

ext_test_named_org.note: No outside organisation named as testing safety or risk.

ext_test_timing_stated.note: No outside safety testing, so no timing stated.

safeguards_training.note: Post-training (SFT, GRPO, OPD, generative reward model) is for capability; no safety, refusal or harmlessness training described. RLHF is mentioned only as the conventional alternative the lab replaced (Sec 5.1.1).

safeguards_runtime.note: No classifiers, filters or moderation for deployment. 'cluster monitor (Watcher)' is sandbox infrastructure and 'web-sourced data filtering' is data cleaning; neither is a safety mechanism.

safeguards_access.note: No access restrictions tied to safety.

safeguards_weights.note: No protection of model weights described; weights released openly via Hugging Face link.
